name: 穷查理宝典
detailText: 阅读《穷查理宝典》时的核心概念与生词。可继续从书中摘录加入本词库。

cards.sentence: You've got to have models in your head and array your experience on this latticework of mental models.
cards.back:
思维模型格栅

把多个学科的核心模型组合起来，用于理解现实与做决策。

逆向思考

先想如何失败，再反推如何避免；比只追求成功路径更有效。

cards.sentence: You have to figure out what your own aptitudes are and play games where you have an edge.
cards.back:
能力圈

知道自己真正懂什么，只在能力圈内下注；圈外要更谨慎或不去。

cards.sentence: The margin of safety is always dependent on the price paid.
cards.back:
安全边际

留出容错空间：即使判断有误，也不至于伤筋动骨。

人类误判心理学

系统认识认知偏差（激励、从众、锚定等），减少重复犯错。

cards.sentence: Understanding both the power of compound interest and the difficulty of getting it is the heart of understanding a lot of things.
cards.front: Understanding both the power of ______ and the difficulty of getting it is the heart of understanding a lot of things.
cards.back:
compound interest

复利：长期积累的小优势，会随时间放大。

基本世俗智慧

来自多学科的基础模型 + 常出现的行为模式，构成实用判断力。

cards.sentence: The iron rule of nature is: you get what you reward for.
cards.front: You get what you reward for.
cards.back:
激励决定行为

人们会走向被奖励的方向；设计制度时先看激励结构。
